app.name: PdfTwist
app.tagline: Modern PDF tools. Private. Free. Open Source.

home.hero: All your PDF tools in one place
home.subhero: Free, private, and open source. Files are processed locally where possible — never stored.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Reduce file size while preserving quality.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.desc: Combine multiple PDFs into one document.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Extract pages or split by range, bookmarks, or size.

pageTools.title: Page Tools
pageTools.desc: Rotate, delete, reorder, and extract pages.

pdfToImage.title: PDF to Image
pdfToImage.desc: Convert PDF pages to PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

imageToPdf.title: Image to PDF
imageToPdf.desc: Combine images into a single PDF document.

protect.title: Protect PDF
protect.desc: Add password protection and encryption to PDFs.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.desc: Add text or image watermarks to PDF pages.

pageNumbers.title: Page Numbers
pageNumbers.desc: Add page numbers with custom formatting.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.desc: View and edit PDF document properties.

annotate.title: Annotate PDF
annotate.desc: Add text, highlights, shapes, and drawings.

redact.title: Redact PDF
redact.desc: Black out sensitive content in your PDF.

dropzone.title: Drop PDF files here
dropzone.multipleHint: Drop multiple files to process them together

privacy.tooltip: Browser-processable operations run 100% locally. Server-processed files are deleted within 30 minutes.
